intent.raw: Improve the ontologize design: it does not say how we structure the DAG, which events update it, which metrics we track, and how we improve it over time. Reuse the GoldenQuill work already done.
intent.objective: Run the canonical refine loop to turn the abstract ontologize promotion-DAG/BI design into a concrete DAG-and-metrics design: node and edge types, the event model that updates the DAG, evidence-linked metric families, and the improve-over-time loop, instantiated for the cap factory and logistics verticals, reusing GoldenQuill's grant_dag implementation and KPI families as source evidence.
intent.operator_sentence: Make the DAG and metrics concrete by reusing the GoldenQuill promotion-record DAG and KPI work.

technique_overlays.trigger: The operator asked specifically for the unstated DAG node/edge/event structure and metric set.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Distill and redesign must emit a concrete structural artifact (DAG-AND-METRICS.md) naming node types, edge types, events, and metrics, each traced to a GoldenQuill source path or marked hypothesis.

technique_overlays.trigger: The operator said a lot of work is already done in GoldenQuill and in our prior extraction receipts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Reuse GoldenQuill grant_dag (master) and pattern-extraction-receipts.md; dedup against prior findings; record residue rather than re-deriving.

route_menu.context_hint: Single technique profile selected: x-ray to surface the concrete DAG structure plus memory reuse of GoldenQuill prior work. Dialectic/tournament not applicable (make-concrete task, no competing-principle tension).

items.label: X-ray + memory reuse

subagent_strategy.explanation: The GoldenQuill DAG and metric evidence is already captured in pattern-extraction-receipts.md and the grant_dag source on master can be read directly inside the distill/redesign stages; a parallel fanout would duplicate completed work.
